BiblicalUsage: Naaran is a town in the territory of Ephraim, named once in the list of possessions. In 1 Chronicles 7:28 the possessions and habitations of Ephraim are listed, and eastward Naaran stands among them with Bethel and Gezer and Shechem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a town named once in a list is still part of the inheritance God gave. Naaran is not a famous place, but it is counted land.
